item: Terminal panel log view sets cbreak before it asks for a key
summary: The Server messages view wrote its Press any key prompt before tty.setcbreak, so a key pressed at once landed in line mode or was discarded by the TCSAFLUSH and the view did not return (CI flake on test_the_server_messages_view_returns_on_any_key). cbreak is now set first and the prompt is written inside the try that restores the terminal; a source-order test pins it.
